mapper.insert: insert into ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base (card_name, card_prize, card_desc, card_start_time, card_end_time, card_num) values (#{cardName}, #{cardPrize}, #{cardDesc}, #{cardStartTime}, #{cardEndTime}, #{cardNum})
mapper.select:
select if(ISNULL(sum(card_money)),0,sum(card_money)) from ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base a RIGHT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info b on a.card_id=b.card_id
where b.user_account='' =''

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ot.card_id, ot.card_name, ot.card_desc, ot.card_start_time, ot.card_end_time FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base ot LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info ob ON ot.card_id = ob.card_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY ot.card_id ORDER BY ot.card_id DESC ) oy1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count( 1 ) unused, ot.card_id id FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info ob, ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base ot WHERE ob.user_account = '' AND ot.card_id = ob.card_id GROUP BY ot.card_id ) oy ON oy1.card_id = oy.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT card_id, count(*) card_num FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info GROUP BY card_id ) ob ON ob.card_id = oy1.card_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ot.card_id, count( 1 ) usecount FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base ot LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info ob ON ot.card_id = ob.card_id WHERE ob.user_account != '' GROUP BY ot.card_id ) oe ON oe.card_id = oy1.card_id
order by oy1.card_id desc
select COALESCE(sum(card_money),0) from ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base a RIGHT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info b on a.card_id=b.card_id where b.user_account=''

SELECT ob.card_code, ob.card_money, ob.card_id, ob.card_fetch_time, ob.user_id, ob.user_account, ob.card_password, ot.card_desc, ot.card_start_time, ot.card_end_time FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info ob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base ot ON ot.card_id = ob.card_id where 1=1
and user_id != 0 and user_id =#{param.userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and user_id != 0
and user_id = 0
and parent_id = #{param.parentId}
and card_code LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{param.cardCode}), '%')
and (card_fetch_time BETWEEN #{param.startDate} and #{param.endDate})
ORDER BY ob.card_fetch_time DESC limit 6000

SELECT ob.card_code, ob.card_money, ob.card_id, ob.card_fetch_time, ob.user_id, ui.user_mobile as userAccount, ob.card_password, ot.card_desc, ot.card_start_time, ot.card_end_time FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info ob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base ot ON ot.card_id = ob.card_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui ON ui.user_id = ob.user_id where 1=1
and ob.user_id != 0 and ob.user_id = #{param.userId}
and ob.user_id != 0
and ob.user_id = 0
and parent_id = #{param.parentId}
and card_code LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{param.cardCode}), '%')
and (card_fetch_time BETWEEN #{param.startDate} and #{param.endDate})
ORDER BY ob.card_fetch_time DESC

SELECT IFNULL(sum(card_money),0) FROM ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_info ob LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.payment}hou_pay_card_base ot ON ot.card_id = ob.card_id where 1=1
and ob.user_id != 0 and ob.user_id = #{param.userId}
